changes.description: Added coordinate domain validation, outOfDomainBehavior policies, valueCategory categorization (TARGET, PREDICTED, MEASURED), physical parameter sanity enforcement (E > 0, -1 < nu < 0.5, rho > 0), and cryptographic SHA-256 state hashing.

Implemented strict fail-closed validation for element.spatialFieldId: verified field presence in model, verified base material match, threw error if property E is undefined, and preserved legacy baseline without regressions.

Implemented strict fail-closed validation for element.spatialFieldId in computeMatrices and computeStressStrain: verified field presence, base material match, missing property E, added spatial Poisson's ratio (nu) evaluation, and preserved legacy baseline.
Enforced fail-closed rejection of spatial field binding with explicit [UNSUPPORTED_FORMULATION_SPATIAL_FIELD] error, classifying capability as NOT_YET_IMPLEMENTED.
Implemented canonical serialization for Map, Set, and spatial material fields, added spatialFieldHash to evidence packages, and implemented isEvidenceStale for mutation detection.
Built complete numerical benchmark suite (Tests A-F) and 13 adversarial / invalidation tests (PMV3-ADV-001 to PMV3-ADV-013).
